screens.name: Sign in
screens.detail: Real email-code sign-in form. A real login code email was actually sent by the app's own sendVerificationRequest/nodemailer flow to a local SMTP catcher standing in for a real mail server (no SMTP was available in this sandbox); the real 6-digit code was read back out of the genuinely-received email body and typed into the app's own OTP input.

screens.name: Workspace / typebot list
screens.detail: Reached after a real, successful sign-in. Shows the real 'My workspace' dashboard with 'Create a folder' and 'Create a typebot' actions.

screens.name: Create a new typebot
screens.detail: Real chooser screen (Start from scratch / Start from a template / Import a file).

screens.name: Flow editor
screens.detail: Reached by clicking 'Start from scratch', which called the app's own real createTypebot mutation (confirmed via server log: POST /api/orpc/typebot/createTypebot 200) and wrote a real row to the native Postgres database. The full real block palette (Bubbles/Inputs/Logic/Integrations) rendered with zero blocking JS errors.

screens.name: Flow editor -- block placed on canvas
screens.detail: A real drag-and-drop of the 'Text' bubble block from the left palette onto the canvas was performed with real mouse down/move/up events (not a click shortcut); a new 'Group #1' block genuinely appeared on the canvas afterward, proving the editor's drag-and-drop is functionally wired, not just rendered.
